rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that has physically frozen or is kept frozen.

example.english: The fish fillets in the freezer are already frozen.
example.traditional: 雪櫃入面啲魚柳已經冰凍喇。
example.jyutping: syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6 di1 jyu4 lau5 ji5 ging1 bing1 dung3 laa3

rows.meaning: unable to move; paralysed with fear
rows.note: Use this when someone is stunned or stands still from fear and cannot react.

example.english: When I saw that scene, I was completely frozen.
example.traditional: 見到咁嘅場面，我成個呆住咗。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 gam3 ge3 coeng4 min6 ngo5 seng4 go3 daai1 zyu6 zo2

rows.note: Use this in financial or administrative contexts when an account or funds cannot be used for transactions.

example.english: The bank has frozen my account.
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 dung3 git3 zo2 ngo5 go3 wu6 hau2
